crossRefs.note: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

translations.web: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.
translations.bsb: and seven pairs of every kind of bird of the air, male and female, to preserve their offspring on the face of all the earth.
translations.kjv: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
translations.asv: of the birds also of the heavens, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
